h.O StarTouch é uma plataforma que ajuda n: StarTouch is a platform that helps local Brazilian businesses collect more 5-star reviews on Google.
h.Sim. O StarTouch leva o cliente direto p: Yes. StarTouch takes customers straight to your business page on Google Maps/Search — so your business needs to be listed there.
h.O cadastro é gratuito em google.com/busi: Signing up is free at google.com/business and takes less than 10 minutes. If you don't have one yet, create it first and then activate StarTouch.
h.O plano gratuito é grátis pra sempre, se: The free plan is free forever, no credit card. Every activated device takes customers straight to review you on Google, with no monthly fee.
h.Você paga uma vez pelo hardware (cartão,: You pay once for the hardware (card, stand or wristband, from R$ 29,90 to R$ 109,90). The dashboard comes with it for free — your rating, your reviews, a weekly negative-review alert, your local ranking position, competitors and a weekly email summary.
h.Existe uma assinatura opcional, o StarTo: There's one optional subscription, StarTouch Pro: 7 days free, then R$ 19,90 per month, no commitment. It unlocks the Smart Menu. If you never subscribe, the device and the dashboard keep working just the same.
h.Restaurantes, bares, cafés, salões, barb: Restaurants, bars, cafés, salons, barbershops, clinics, practices, shops, repair shops, gyms, hotels, events. If your customers pass by your counter or front desk, you can use it.
h.Depende do seu volume de clientes. Negóc: It depends on your customer volume. A business with 30 customers a day usually sees its first reviews on the same day it activates.
h.A média é 1 avaliação a cada 8-12 client: On average, 1 in every 8–12 customers who tap the device leaves a review. The effect on your Google ranking shows up in 2 to 4 weeks — when Google's algorithm recalculates your profile with the new reviews.
h.Sim, todos os iPhones do modelo 7 em dia: Yes, every iPhone from the iPhone 7 onward (released in 2016) reads NFC natively.
h.A maioria dos Android modernos (de 2017: Most modern Android phones (from 2017 on) have NFC. To check, go to Settings → Connections (or Connectivity) and look for NFC — if it's there, just turn it on.
h.Todo dispositivo StarTouch tem um QR Cod: Every StarTouch device has a QR code printed next to the NFC chip.
h.Infinitas vezes. Cada cliente novo que e: Unlimited times. Every new customer who taps it can leave their review.
h.Não. Os dispositivos NFC são passivos —: No. NFC devices are passive — they run only on the energy from the phone's tap.
h.Não têm bateria, não precisam de WiFi, n: They have no battery, don't need Wi-Fi and give off no signal when no phone is near. The one that needs internet is the customer's phone, to open the Google page.

From the second one on, choose "I already have a StarTouch account", log in and the system automatically links it to the same business.

h.Só facilita o caminho: o cliente que que: It just makes the path easier: a customer who wants to leave a review can do it in 1 tap instead of searching for your business, scrolling and clicking on stars. Google allows and encourages this practice — making it easier isn't manipulating.
h.Responda publicamente, com educação e of: Reply publicly, politely, and offer a solution. Google rewards profiles that reply — it will help you climb the ranking despite the low rating.
h.Evite discutir, peça pra continuar a con: Avoid arguing; ask to continue the conversation privately ("reach us at (area code) XXXX-XXXX").
h.Uma resposta bem feita transforma uma cr: A well-written reply turns criticism into positive social proof for future customers who are reading.
h.Não, e a StarTouch não faz isso. Todo cl: No, and StarTouch doesn't do that. Every customer who taps the device goes to the same Google review page, with the same rating options available.
h.Perguntar \"como foi?\" antes e desviar: Asking "how was it?" first and diverting unhappy customers to a private form has a name — review gating — and Google prohibits it. The risk isn't a warning: it's Google removing the reviews you got that way.
h.O caminho compatível é o que a StarTouch: The compliant approach is what StarTouch does: reduce friction for people who already want to leave a review. One tap instead of searching, scrolling and hunting for the button. Happy customers are the ones who most often give up halfway — and that's the customer the device wins back.
h.Pelo Google Meu Negócio (no celular ou e: Through your Google Business Profile (on your phone or at google.com/business).
h.Entre em startouch.com.br/app, vá em Con: Log in at startouch.com.br/app and go to Settings → Business. There you can update your display name, registered address and category.
h.Atenção: o endereço que aparece no Googl: Note: the address shown on Google comes from your Google Business Profile (it can't be changed through StarTouch). To change it there, go to google.com/business.
h.Hoje, quando o cliente encosta o celular: Today, when a customer taps your device, they go straight to your Google review page. With the Smart Menu, that same tap opens a menu with several options: WhatsApp, food menu, booking, Instagram, contact — whatever you choose.
h.A avaliação no Google continua sendo a p: The Google review is always the first option. It's pinned to the top and never leaves the menu. Pro adds options; it never replaces what you already had.
h.Você monta o menu de graça e vê como fic: You can build the menu for free and see how it looks before deciding. It's in the dashboard, under Smart Menu.
h.7 dias grátis e depois R$ 19,90 por mês,: 7 days free, then R$ 19,90 per month, no commitment. It covers all your devices — it's not charged per device.
h.Não. Mudou o cardápio, a promoção ou o n: No. Changed your food menu, a promotion or your WhatsApp number? Edit it in the dashboard, click publish, and it applies right away, on every device. The card and the stand stay the same.
h.E o menu também tem um endereço próprio:: The menu also has its own web address: you can paste it in your Instagram bio, your WhatsApp status or a printed QR code, with no device needed at all.
h.Não se perde nada. Ao fim do período pag: Nothing is lost. At the end of the paid period, your devices go back to taking customers straight to the Google review — and the menu you built stays saved in the dashboard, just as it was.

h.O cancelamento vale a partir do fim do p: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid (no charge the following month). The hardware you bought is yours forever — it keeps working on the free plan.
